catalyst.title: The Radiant Catalyst
catalyst.description: The explosive energy of Fire meets your High Novelty Seeking (NS) to create unprecedented change. The celestial influence grants your innovation a destiny-bound legitimacy.
catalyst.friction: Excessive expansion can deplete your fuel quickly; pacing is essential.
catalyst.synergy: Your inner passion resonates perfectly with external opportunities.

bastion.title: The Obsidian Bastion
bastion.description: The heavy stability of Earth combined with your caution builds an impregnable foundation for life. Under celestial protection, you possess the wisdom to wait for the perfect moment.
bastion.friction: Static comfort zones may hinder growth.

traveler.title: The Harmonious Traveler
traveler.description: You navigate life with a balanced alignment between your innate fate and modern psychology. Your journey is one of integration.
traveler.friction: Lack of a singular, dominant drive.
